verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an embeddable vector database and SDK like LanceDB, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or an opt-out mechanism. The Apache-2.0 license and Enterprise compliance claims (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) are adjacent and do not show a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
